title: Private House Design 212 m², Kharkiv | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 212 m² private house in Kharkiv: design project, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Private house interior design in Kharkiv, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 212 m²

blocks.text: Private house interior design in Kharkiv, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 212 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a comprehensive project for a 212 m² private house in Kharkiv, Ukraine. The project combined interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a full turnkey renovation of the house.

The design covers all the main rooms of the house: the living room, bedrooms, a children’s room, a kitchen with built-in appliances, an entrance hall, bathrooms, and functional storage systems. The layout and interior solutions were developed as a single concept with a focus on ergonomics, functionality, and comfortable everyday use of the space.

Custom furniture was designed and manufactured for the rooms. The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, shelving, and storage systems were designed around the architecture of the house, the room dimensions, and the client’s functional requirements. This approach made it possible to integrate the furniture directly into the interior and make the most of the available space.

Before implementation began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and other items specified in the project. Once the design stage was complete, a full turnkey renovation of the private house in Kharkiv was carried out in line with the developed technical documentation.

Photorealistic 3D visualizations were also prepared for the project, making it possible to preview the future interior and the combination of materials, furniture, color schemes, and lighting before implementation began.

This 212 m² private house project showcases DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s end-to-end approach — from the development of the interior design and technical solutions to the manufacture of custom furniture and full implementation of the interior.
